source_autosprite.base_provenance: v003 magenta source despilled to a flat transparent base, tight-reframed to ~74% width / ~65% height fill (matches lunabi base_padded footprint), then uploaded as a NEW character to avoid the dirty-magenta fringe of the original maribo character.
source_autosprite.prompt: 49-frame click-reaction Live2D one-shot for Maribo the chibi pink dolphin Ringpet. Start neutral, then a surprised bounce: eyes widen then settle into a cheerful smile, fins flick, the cyan trident spear lifts and tips slightly with a small cyan water-droplet splash sparkle, one brief playful sway/half-spin, teal shell armor shimmer, then settle. Keep identity, the full trident spear, and shell armor stable and fully inside frame at all times. Transparent background, generous safe margins, no text, no UI, no extra characters, no crop.

runtime_sheet.frame_interval: intended 16 fps one-shot pingpong; 49 AutoSprite frames + deterministic reverse 48..0

postprocess.tool: AutoSprite-derived per-cell Real-ESRGAN animev3 x2 RGB/alpha split + 0.92 safe-margin pingpong repack
postprocess.operation: AutoSprite 49f source cells were alpha-bleed RGB upscaled through Real-ESRGAN animev3 x2, recombined with separately resized source alpha, safe-margin repacked at 0.92 into 1152px cells, then deterministic forward+reverse 98f pingpong reassembly.

unsharp_mask.mode: per-cell RGB unsharp after Real-ESRGAN upscale and before safe-margin alpha recombine.

alpha_cleanup.operation: Post-upscale alpha cleanup: source alpha resized separately and pixels with alpha <= 15 set fully transparent after recombine.

realesrgan_upscale.alpha_recombine: source alpha resized separately, alpha<=15 clipped after recombine

qa.fringe_check: HQ1152 dark preview inspected at .tmp/maribo_click_hq/maribo_click_current_raw_realesrgan_animev3_hq1152_safe_dark_preview.png; same-size comparison inspected at .tmp/maribo_click_hq/compare_current_vs_hq1152_safe_dark.png.

root_cause_note: Maribo previously read lower-quality than Lunabi because (1) the v003 magenta source was NOT a flat #ff00ff chroma key (corners ranged R218-235, G10-36, B185-209), so chroma removal could never be clean; and (2) maribo's body is pink, which is close in hue to magenta, so AutoSprite removeBg left magenta/pink edge fringe. Per the CLAUDE.md chroma-key rule, a pink character should use a green (#00ff00) key, not magenta. Lunabi's dark-purple body + perfectly flat #ff00ff source avoided both problems. This asset fixes (1)+(2) by despilling to a clean transparent base before upload.
